proof: B⇒A is immediate from exact-class witness semantics.
For A⇒B, each Z_i=im(W_i→T) is Zariski closed because W_i→T is proper.
An irreducible finite-type variety over uncountable C cannot be a countable union of proper Zariski-closed subsets; hence some Z_i=T.

lesson.lesson: Before crediting proper-moduli domination as a geometric reduction, type whether the claim is (i) some exact witness component dominates, (ii) a component through the selected witness dominates, or (iii) a bounded/canonical replaceable family dominates. In a countably parameterized proper setting, (i) can be equivalent to the original pointwise existence statement; only (ii)/(iii) add a genuine transport constraint, and they require independent source geometry.
lesson.reuse_scope: moduli/incidence routes with countably many proper parameter families over an irreducible uncountable-field base
